workers.name: brainstormer
workers.description: Generates distinct creative options for a scoped story question without forcing convergence.

workers.name: character-sim
workers.description: Simulates a specified character to test voice, motivation, and relationships.

workers.name: continuity-checker
workers.description: Cross-references a draft against supplied canon, timeline, state, and vocabulary.

workers.name: critic
workers.description: Performs a deep, passage-grounded critique of one high-value focus area.

workers.name: editor
workers.description: Provides an independent editorial diagnosis at the requested edit level.

workers.name: outliner
workers.description: Turns a confirmed direction into an arc, chapter, scene, or beat blueprint.

workers.name: reader-sim
workers.description: Reports the felt reading experience from a specified persona and knowledge boundary.

workers.name: style-creator
workers.description: Derives a reusable project style reference from supplied prose samples and constraints.

workers.name: web-researcher
workers.description: Researches factual and cultural detail for fiction using attributable sources.

workers.name: writer
workers.description: Produces or revises fiction from an approved brief, context, and style references.
